# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 17
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 17

---

*[THE END. He is taken up. The disciples are left behind. The final words.]*

1. Even while he was still speaking — he was taken up into the heavens. A great cloud of light came and received him. And we saw words written on that cloud: "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. He has kept my commandments."

2. We stood there weeping. We were sorrowful beyond words, because we could no longer see him.

3. Moses and Elijah had gone up into the heavens with him. There they heard the voice of God saying to them: "Go to my holy mountain. Stay there until the day of my coming — the day that will be fulfilled in the generation yet to come."

4. We fell on our faces. We praised God and the Lord. And we watched the cloud pull away from us and rise into heaven.

5. Then Moses and Elijah came back down from the holy mountain. They were weeping. They were lamenting. "He has gone up," they said. "He has left us."

6. We fell on our faces again and wept again, because our Lord had gone away from us.

7. And the Lord Jesus Christ was taken from the midst of us, and he went up into heaven. A voice from heaven said: "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

8. And many were gathered in his name. They were counted righteous in his name. They were made holy. Their sins were forgiven.

9. Before he left us, our Lord Jesus Christ had said to us: "I am giving you authority over serpents and scorpions and the power of the enemy, over every sickness and disease — and whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven."

10. And he had said to us: "Go. Make disciples of all the nations. Baptize them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

11. And remember — as I have told you before — the prophets already spoke about everything I have shown you."

12. And we praised God. We glorified him. And we went out and proclaimed the kingdom of heaven everywhere, in his name. We preached repentance. We preached forgiveness of sins. We preached it in all the world.

---
*PNEUMA note: The Apocalypse of Peter ends with the disciples weeping — twice — as the Lord recedes into heaven. Even Moses and Elijah weep. The tears of the disciples frame the ending, echoing the tears of those in hell at the apocalypse's center. But this grief is different: it is the grief of those who have seen glory and must now go into the world and speak of it. The final verse — they preached everywhere — is the release. The vision becomes mission.*
